meta.name: sl
meta.description: ktx's semantic layer - a structured catalog of sources (tables/views), measures, joins, and segments expressed as YAML. Covers the schema and how to query it via `sl_query`. Use when the task involves querying pre-defined metrics (ARR, churn, retention, LTV, MAU) or reading SL source YAML to understand the catalog. Capture is handled by the `sl_capture` skill (memory-agent only).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询预定义业务指标和语义层目录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过语义层查询ARR、留存等业务指标
copy.tagline_en: Query predefined business metrics and semantic layer catalog
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query business metrics like ARR, retention via semantic layer

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询预定义的业务指标（如 ARR、流失率、留存率、LTV、MAU）或读取语义层 YAML 源文件来理解数据目录。它使用 `sl_query` 工具自动生成 SQL，处理连接、聚合和过滤。
howto.when: 当任务涉及查询预定义指标或需要理解语义层目录结构时触发。例如，用户询问“本月 ARR 是多少？”或“查看 fct_orders 源的结构”。

say.text: 查询本月 ARR 趋势，按月分组。
显示 fct_orders 源的所有度量。
say.note: Claude 会读取语义层 YAML 并列出度量。

say.text: 计算每个客户分段的平均健康评分。
say.note: Claude 会跨源连接并聚合数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query predefined business metrics (e.g., ARR, churn, retention, LTV, MAU) or read semantic layer YAML source files to understand the catalog. It uses the `sl_query` tool to auto-generate SQL, handling joins, aggregations, and filters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves querying predefined metrics or understanding the semantic layer catalog structure. For example, when the user asks 'What is this month's ARR?' or 'Show the structure of the fct_orders source.'

say_en.text: Query monthly ARR trend, grouped by month.
say_en.note: Claude will use sl_query to generate SQL and return results.

say_en.text: Show all measures from the fct_orders source.
say_en.note: Claude will read the semantic layer YAML and list measures.

say_en.text: Calculate average health score per customer segment.
say_en.note: Claude will join across sources and aggregate data.
